description: This file, `project_functions.py`, contains various functions for handling BORIS project data, including loading, validating, and exporting project information; managing file paths; checking project integrity; and utility functions related to events, subjects, and media. It serves as a core component for project data management within the BORIS behavioral observation software.

methods.name: float check_observation_exhaustivity( events: List[list], state_events_list: list = [], )
methods.description: Calculates the observation exhaustivity percentage based on events, state events, and ethogram. Determines how thoroughly the observation period has been covered.

methods.name: float check_observation_exhaustivity_pictures(obs)
methods.description: Evaluates the exhaustivity of coded images by comparing the number of images in directories with the number of coded images.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] behavior_category(ethogram: dict)
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping behavior codes to their behavioral categories based on the ethogram.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] check_if_media_available(observation: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Checks whether media and image files required for observations are available in specified directories.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] check_directories_availability(observation: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Verifies that all directories listed in an observation exist and are accessible.

methods.name: bool check_coded_behaviors_in_obs_list(pj: dict, observations_list: list)
methods.description: Validates that all behaviors coded in the current observations are defined in the ethogram.

methods.name: list get_modifiers_of_behavior(ethogram, behavior: str)
methods.description: Retrieves all modifiers associated with a specific behavior from the ethogram.

methods.name: set check_coded_behaviors(pj: dict)
methods.description: Identifies behaviors coded in observations that are not defined in the ethogram.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] check_state_events_obs(obsId: str, ethogram: dict, observation: dict, time_format: str = cfg.HHMMSS)
methods.description: Checks whether state events in a specific observation are properly paired and correctly defined.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,tuple] check_state_events(pj: dict, observations_list: list)
methods.description: Validates pairing of state events across multiple observations, removes unpaired ones, and reports issues.

methods.name: str check_project_integrity( pj: dict, time_format: str, project_file_name: str, media_file_available: bool = True, )
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of the project, including behavior definitions, media availability, timestamp correctness, subject consistency, and more.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] create_subtitles(pj: dict, selected_observations: list, parameters: dict, export_dir: str)
methods.description: Generates subtitle files for selected observations, exporting event sequences as synchronized subtitles, with coloring based on subject.

methods.name: bool export_observations_list(pj: dict, selected_observations: list, file_name: str, output_format: str)
methods.description: Exports a list of selected observations in various formats (CSV, TSV, HTML, ODS, XLSX).

methods.name: bool set_media_paths_relative_to_project_dir(pj: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Adjusts media and image directory paths to be relative to the project file location.

methods.name: bool set_data_paths_relative_to_project_dir(pj: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Adjusts data file paths to be relative to the project configuration.

methods.name: None remove_data_files_path(pj: dict)
methods.description: Removes file paths from data plots and annotations.

methods.name: bool remove_media_files_path(pj: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Removes file paths, replacing with filenames only, from media and image directories, updating project data accordingly.

methods.name: str full_path(path: str, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Returns the absolute path for a given media or data file, relative to the project file.

methods.name: Tuple[dec,dec] observed_interval(observation: dict)
methods.description: Calculates the start and end times of observed events within an observation.

methods.name: List[tuple] events_start_stop(ethogram: dict, events: list, obs_type: str)
methods.description: Determines whether events are start or stop or point events based on sequence.

methods.name: list extract_observed_subjects(pj: dict, selected_observations: list)
methods.description: Collects unique subjects observed in selected observations.

methods.name: tuple open_project_json(project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Loads a BORIS project file from JSON or gzipped JSON, performs version checks, and updates older formats to current schema.

methods.name: check_coded_behaviors_in_obs_list
methods.description: Validates that all behaviors coded in observations are defined in the ethogram.

methods.name: str|None event_type(code: str, ethogram: dict)
methods.description: Returns the behavior type (point or state) based on behavior code by consulting the ethogram.

methods.name: list fix_unpaired_state_events(ethogram: dict, observation: dict, fix_at_time: dec)
methods.description: Fixes unpaired state events in an observation at a given time by adding closing events where necessary.

methods.name: list fix_unpaired_state_events2(ethogram: dict, events: list, fix_at_time: dec)
methods.description: Fixes unpaired state events in a list of events at a specified timestamp by adding missing closing events.

methods.name: bool has_audio(observation: dict, media_file_path: str)
methods.description: Checks whether a media file associated with an observation contains audio.

methods.name: None explore_project(self)
methods.description: Searches various elements (subjects, behaviors, modifiers, comments) in all observations, displaying matched events.

methods.name: Tuple[str,pd.DataFrame] project2dataframe(pj: dict, observations_list: list = [])
methods.description: Converts project observations and related data into a pandas DataFrame for analysis, retrieving metadata and event sequences.

methods.name: double_click_explore_project(obs_id, event_idx)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: dec interval_len(interval: I)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] subject_color(subject: str)
